clips.title: The story
paras: Tabetha is a reclusive, powerful human mage dwelling deep within Dustwallow Marsh at an isolated farmstead in the Quagmire. Far from the politics of Dalaran or Theramore, she instructs aspiring spellcasters and aids those seeking mastery over potent arcane and occult relics.

Hidden away in the sodden expanse of Dustwallow Marsh north of the Stonemaul Ruins, Tabetha lives in a secluded shack alongside her apprentices. Surrounding herself with alchemical vials and ancient tomes, she has deliberately chosen solitude over the academic hierarchies of the Eastern Kingdoms. Despite her remote location, her mastery of the arcane is renowned enough that spellcasters across Kalimdor brave beasts and mire alike to seek her guidance.

Tabetha stands notably apart from factional hostilities. While human by birth, she turns away neither Alliance nor Horde initiates who demonstrate the will to learn, providing tutelage to mages and assisting warlocks with dangerous bindings such as the Orb of Orahil. Her past connects her to figures like Menara Voidrender, revealing an extensive history with esoteric magic that transcends simple faction allegiance.
